record.title: Report Stage One evidence and proposed Stage Two boundary
record.intent: Return first-contact evidence for operator review without admitting Stage Two.
requirements: Report physical transitions, boot timing, observed network MAC and IP behavior, visible model firmware options, stable UI status, persistent-state prompts, artifact paths and hashes.
Preserve private specimen and host identifiers outside public source. Commit and push only appropriate generic procedure and redacted conclusions.
Recommend a bounded Stage Two based on observations; do not admit or execute Stage Two. Preserve exact host restoration information and state any remaining temporary host configuration.
acceptance: Stage One has a reproducible evidence report and an explicit operator decision boundary.
